# Components App Selection

This layer manages the selection of elements in Excalidraw, the Text field component, and the Component for ellipsifying text.

## Overview

Manages chat functionalities, renders Mermaid diagrams, and handles text generation in Excalidraw components.

## Responsibilities

- **Element Selection**: Manages the selection of elements within the drawing canvas.

## How it works

The `packages/excalidraw/components/Sidebar` folder specifically contains components for the sidebar, which includes the main sidebar component and its styles. The `packages/excalidraw/components/TTDDialog` folder contains components related to the TTDDialog, which is used for creating diagrams using Mermaid syntax. The `packages/excalidraw/components/TTDDialog/hooks` folder manages chat functionalities, renders Mermaid diagrams, and handles text generation within the Excalidraw components. The `packages/excalidraw/components/welcome-screen` folder contains components and styles for the welcome screen, including the main content, hints, and styling.

## Configuration

- Configuration files: `packages/excalidraw/tsconfig.json`.
